questions.question: Write a food chain from the game drive and explain what the arrows mean.
questions.expected_answer: Example: Sun, then grass, then zebra, then lion, joined by arrows. Each arrow means is eaten by or gives energy to, and points from the food to the eater, showing the direction the energy moves.

questions.question: Why does every food chain start with a plant?
questions.expected_answer: Plants are the only living things that can make their own food, using energy from sunlight. Animals cannot make food, so they depend on plants, either by eating them or by eating animals that ate them.

questions.question: Explain what would happen to lions if a drought killed most of the grass.
questions.expected_answer: The zebra and other grazers would have little to eat, so many would become weak, move away or die. Then the lions would have fewer animals to hunt, so they would go hungry, even though they do not eat grass.
